surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
This implementation is governed by safety-document clause 4, which permits only the executables /usr/bin/printf and /bin/echo and requires rejection of all others, direct vector argument passing, and disabled shell processing. The function run_text_utility must validate the executable parameter by exact string comparison against the two allowlisted paths /usr/bin/printf and /bin/echo. If the executable is neither of these two strings, the function must raise ValueError and must not attempt any subprocess invocation. When validation succeeds, the function must execute the specified binary with the supplied arguments list passed directly as an argument vector, explicitly disabling shell processing so that no shell interpolation, expansion, or metacharacter handling occurs. The function must capture the subprocess standard output stream as text, return the captured output as a string, and allow any subprocess or process execution failures to propagate to the caller without interception or translation.
END_PLAN
